notes: The negative constructions (Robert Walsh's unrelated MCP message and Morgan Stanley's delay message, both added to C03IJKL9012 in T01WORKSPACE) test the selector's user-binding across channel membership and message authorship, but they do not introduce a spurious *workspace* answer: T01WORKSPACE is already a true positive via core-infra/Robert Chen, so no distinct incorrect root workspace is produced by these negatives (they operate at the user/message level, not the workspace level). Hence negative_referents is empty at the WORKSPACE root; the negative value lies in confirming the selector's real_name+content filters correctly exclude Robert Walsh (wrong content) and Morgan Stanley (wrong name) from being treated as the qualifying member. Because the task is explicitly underspecified with scope:[], the selector returns both T01WORKSPACE and T02NEBULA as the union of eligible alternatives, matching the design's intended ambiguity. Access is supported because agent1 (U01AGENBOT9) now holds workspace and channel memberships in both T01WORKSPACE (core-infra, engineering, etc.) and T02NEBULA (general), enabling users.conversations/conversations.history discovery of both candidate chains without any workspace-name lookup.
